1
The fluidgives you a strong allergic
reaction. Lose 1 Life. Save vs. L3
poison or lose 1 additional Life every
time you move to a new area. As
soon as you successfully save, the
allergic reaction ends and you stop
taking damage.
2 The fluid has no effect on you.

3
The fluid gives you supernatural
reflexes. Add +1 to all Defense rolls
and ignore surprise attacks from
monsters for the next 3 encounters,
after which the effect ends.

4
The fluid gives you superhuman
strength. Your melee attacks all
inflict+1 damage. The effect wears
off after your next 3 combat
encounters.

5
The fluid heals all damage  you
have taken, bringing you back to
your maximum Life point total.

6
The fluid gives you superior aim.
Gain +1 to hit with ranged
weapons for your next 3 combat
encounters.

zh-CN.title: 液体表（D6）
text:
1
液体引发强烈过敏反应。损失1点生命。进行L3毒素防御检定；失败则每次移动到新区域时额外损失1点生命。成功通过检定后，过敏反应立即结束，不再受到伤害。
2 液体对你没有影响。

3
液体赋予你超自然反射。接下来3次遭遇中，所有防御检定+1，并无视怪物突袭；效果随后结束。

4
液体赋予你超人力量。所有近战攻击额外造成1点伤害。经过接下来3场战斗后，效果消退。

5
液体治愈你受到的所有伤害，使生命恢复至上限。

6
液体赋予你精准瞄准能力。接下来3场战斗中，远程武器命中检定+1。
